## Shared blockers and release gates

- **Authenticated lifecycle (all unpublished entries):** configured local app session reports `user:null`. No authenticated save, publish, public-render/reopen cycle can be verified. Keep all affected designs unpublished.
- **Monochrome Editorial source asset:** `tear-edge-top-b-v4.png` is referenced by the captured source module but is absent from both supplied capture trees; exact URL returned 404. Do not claim source visual parity.
- **Xatna source assets:** `farewell-embroidered-arch.webp` and `quote-divider.webp` are referenced by the captured source module but absent from both supplied capture trees; exact URLs returned 404. Do not claim source visual parity.
- **Amru Maruf:** exact Vue module and fonts are recovered, the app renderer is integrated, and the live catalog row remains unpublished. The authenticated lifecycle remains blocked by the shared session gate.
- **Manor source-only field:** the exact source shows a per-guest table assignment, but the invitation contract has no seating/table field. Do not hardcode source demo seating in real invitations. **Olive Manor:** the app-preview blank state is fixed; source-to-app parity remains open.
- **Workspace state:** existing and concurrent modifications are present across other invitation work. Preserve them. Do not stage/revert broad paths; no releases were committed in this continuation.

## Verification evidence

- Focused checks passed for all seven saved designs: Manor 4/4, Islamic 4/4, Olive Manor 4/4, Osh 5/5, Amru 4/4, Monochrome Editorial 4/4, and Xatna 4/4 (29/29 total). Olive Manor, Amru, Monochrome, Xatna and Osh renderer JS syntax checks passed.
- The production build TypeScript phase passed after the final renderer and iframe-title changes. A separate `tsc --noEmit` run also passed against a temporary config targeting check6 generated types; the standard `pnpm typecheck` cannot find default `.next/types` in this checkout while all builds use isolated output.
- Workspace production build passed after all current template integrations using isolated `.next-einv-template-release-check7` output after the Osh iframe title fix; completed; its generated `BUILD_ID` confirms success.
- The ChatGPT in-app browser was used for Manor and Islamic preview/data checks, Olive Manor mobile preview after its runtime fix, and Amru, Monochrome, and Xatna preview checks. Catalog preview mode selects Emotional Piano; real invitations receive the creator-selected track. RSVP/wishes use app invitation APIs.
- Olive Manor blank-preview bug and Osh localized replacement glyphs are fixed; both mobile app previews now render their captured layouts. No new design has passed every release gate because authenticated lifecycle verification is still unavailable. No new template is published, release-committed, or Telegram-notified.
